definitions.explanation: One's spouse's father, or a stepfather. The 義理 prefix indicates a family relationship by marriage rather than blood.

examples.japanese: {義理|ぎり}の{父|ちち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}した→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧。
{義理|ぎり}の{父|ちち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仲|なか}が{良|よ}い→仲が良い：20668_nakagayoi⟧。
examples.english: I get along well with my father-in-law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{義理|ぎり}の{父|ちち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧{時|とき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was very nervous when I visited my father-in-law's house for the first time after getting married.

notes:
USAGE:
The ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 pattern creates in-law family terms: {義理|ぎり}の{父|ちち} (father-in-law), ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧ (mother-in-law), ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧ (brother/sister-in-law). When speaking about one's own father-in-law to others, use {義理|ぎり}の{父|ちち}. When addressing him directly, use お{義父|とう}さん.

NOTE: ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧ here indicates a relationship by marriage, not by blood.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {義理|ぎり}の{父|ちち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ (to meet one's father-in-law)
- ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧ (parents-in-law)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{義父|ぎふ}→義父：06725_gifu⟧: father-in-law — formal/written equivalent
- お{義父|とう}さん: father-in-law — polite address form
- ⟦{舅|しゅうと}→舅：05109_shuuto⟧: father-in-law — traditional term, also read しゅうとめ for mother-in-law
